:::{#rem-ones-vector-sum}
#### The ones vector sums the entries

The dot product (@def-dot-product) of $\v1$ with $\vx$
is the sum of the entries of $\vx$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\v1 \cdot \vx &= \sumip 1 \cd x_i \\
&= \sumip x_i.
\end{aligned}
$$

For example, for $\vx = (2, -1, 5)$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\v1 \cdot \vx &= 2 + (-1) + 5 \\
&= 6,
\end{aligned}
$$

and dividing by the length $p = 3$ gives the [mean](#def-mean) of the entries, $6 / 3 = 2$.

:::
